summary: Kanzhun Limited filed a Next Day Disclosure Return on Form 6-K with the SEC, reporting share repurchases since March 2026. The company bought back roughly 733,918 to 759,056 shares per day at prices between USD 6.57 and 7.14, cumulatively reducing issued shares. The repurchases are for cancellation, not yet cancelled as of May 21, 2026. Aggregate shares outstanding remain ~840.4M. No advisor is named; the program appears to be an ordinary share buyback executed on-market. Watch for continued buyback pace and impact on EPS; no arbitrage angle as it is a straightforward capital return.
